exposure: Vaginal Birth After Caesarean (VBAC)/Trial of Labor After Caesarean (TOLAC)
outcome: Clinical condition of previous caesarean scar
cohort: The study included 100 term pregnant women with a history of single uncomplicated lower segment caesarean section done for a non-recurrent indication.
finding: VBAC is a safer alternative to elective repeat caesarean section (ERCS) in developing countries and is not associated with increased morbidity and mortality for both babies and mother.
mod_finding: VBAC (Vaginal Birth After Caesarean) is a safer alternative to elective repeat caesarean section and is not associated with increased maternal or neonatal morbidity and mortality.
